scripts.build: npx prisma generate --schema=server/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run build --workspace=client && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); try{if(fs.existsSync('client/dist') && !fs.existsSync('dist')) fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true});}catch(e){}"
scripts.vercel-build: npx prisma generate --schema=server/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run build --workspace=client && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); try{if(fs.existsSync('client/dist') && !fs.existsSync('dist')) fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true});}catch(e){}"
